note: Story cutscene pictures (docs/ui/cutscenes.md), built by tools/art/build_cutscenes.py with art/prompts/cutscene_preamble.txt at 16:9, 2K. {party} expands to `party`. `refs` are character ids whose art/generated/characters/<id>_turnaround.png goes along as a reference. `use` names the take (art/generated/cutscenes/<id>_<take>.png) copied to art/cutscenes/<id>.png. Prompts reviewed by the owner in the Cutscene Audit doc, 2026-10-07.
party: the party, three or four small cloaked and hooded adventurers seen from behind with their faces never visible (one in armour with a sword on the back, one with a staff, one holding up a lantern)

strahd_watcher.prompt: The first time the party leaves the village of Barovia escorting Ireena Kolyana west along the Old Svalich Road, Strahd von Zarovich watches them from a ridge. Low camera on the road looking up past the travellers toward the ridge. Foreground, seen from behind and a little to one side: four small travellers walking the muddy road between dead, twisted trees, cloaked and hooded adventurers whose faces we cannot see (one in plate armour with a sword on the back, one holding up a lantern that throws warm orange light across the mud and the trunks, one hooded with a staff). With them walks Ireena, drawn exactly as the second reference image shows her: long wavy auburn hair, a cream scarf, a dark plum cloak over a blue-grey laced dress, brown boots. She has stopped and turned her head to look up at the ridge, afraid. Above them, high on a bare rocky ridge against a cold, moonlit, cloud-torn sky, Strahd sits perfectly still on a huge, powerful black warhorse whose eyes glow like banked coals. Strahd is drawn exactly as the first reference image shows him: pale gaunt face, slicked black hair, a black high-collared coat with silver frogging, a long black cape lined in blood red, its high red collar standing up; one gloved hand rests on the reins and he looks down at the road, patient and amused. He and his horse are a sharp, clearly readable silhouette rimmed by cold moonlight, the cape stirring in the wind. Far behind him, tiny and faint on a distant cliff in the mist, the spires of Castle Ravenloft with one red-lit window. Grey-green mist pools in the hollows along the road. 16:9 widescreen.

strahd_watcher_alone.prompt: Strahd von Zarovich watches travellers from a ridge above the Old Svalich Road. Low camera on the road looking up past them toward the ridge. Foreground: {party}, walking the muddy road between dead, twisted trees; the lantern throws warm orange light across the mud and the trunks, and the nearest traveller has stopped to look up. Above them, high on a bare rocky ridge against a cold, moonlit, cloud-torn sky, Strahd sits perfectly still on a huge, powerful black warhorse whose eyes glow like banked coals, drawn exactly as his reference shows him: pale gaunt face, slicked black hair, a black high-collared coat with silver frogging, a long black cape lined in blood red; one gloved hand on the reins, looking down at the road, patient and amused. He and his horse are a sharp silhouette rimmed by cold moonlight, the cape stirring. Far behind him, tiny and faint on a distant cliff in the mist, the spires of Castle Ravenloft with one red-lit window. Grey-green mist pools in the hollows along the road.

strahd_watcher_gone.prompt: The same bare rocky ridge above a muddy forest road at night, now empty: a ragged flock of bats lifts off the ridge in a dark streaming cloud and beats away south toward a castle on a distant pillar of rock with one red window. Low camera from the road; {party} in the foreground, looking up. Cold moonlight and cloud, grey-green mist in the hollows, the lantern the only warmth.

mists_arrival.prompt: {party}, small at the bottom of the frame, standing on a muddy road just out of a towering wall of white-grey mist that fills the right of the picture like a closing door. Ahead the Old Svalich Road runs west under black pines and dead trees that lean over it, down into a deep valley ringed by jagged mountains under a pewter sky with no sun anywhere. Far off, tiny and faint, a castle on a pillar of rock with one lit window. High, wide camera from just behind and above the travellers; the only warmth is the lantern one of them lifts, a small orange glow against the cold blue-violet and grey-green of everything else.

death_house_cult.prompt: A low vaulted dungeon chamber under an old townhouse; a ring of tall hooded figures made of black smoke and shadow stand around a stone altar, faces hidden, all turned inward, chanting. Cold green-grey glow from guttering candle stubs on the altar. {party}, small in the archway in the foreground, one lantern raised. Behind the altar, in the dark, a great mound of rotting rushes and refuse rises and falls very slowly, like something asleep.

death_house_lorghoth.prompt: Low camera from the floor of a vaulted crypt looking up: Lorghoth the Decayer heaves upright, a towering hunched heap of grey-brown rot, black mould and sickly green, scraps of black cult robes, bones and candle stubs caught in it, its top scraping the vault, two small sickly-green eyes over a sagging mouth. Ring of shadow cultists unravelling like smoke around it. {party} in silhouette at the bottom edge of the frame, weapons up, dwarfed. Lantern light catches the wet edges; everything else sinks into blue-violet dark.

death_house_window.prompt: Inside a grand old townhouse's upstairs hall, a tall window is closing by itself: wet red brick grows up over the glass row by row from the sill, leaving a ragged gap of grey daylight at the top. {party} scrambles toward it, one figure hurling a chair at the glass; behind them every door in the hall slams and the swords and silver lift off their hooks in the dark. Cold daylight through the gap against warm, sickly lamplight inside; the walls sweat.

death_house_children.prompt: A narrow crypt gallery under the house; two small stone slabs newly closed, candle stubs on them. Two ghost children stand beside them, clearer than ever, in pale moonlit blue, drawn as their references show them: a girl of about ten and her little brother holding a stuffed wolf by one ear, lifting his hand to wave goodbye. The party is only a lantern and two cloaked shoulders in the near foreground. Warm candle glow on the slabs, the children's own cold light fading at the edges. Gentle and sad.

castle_glimpse.prompt: From the muddy western edge of the village of Barovia, past two leaning posts and the last grey, nail-shuttered cottages, the view opens across a misty gorge to Castle Ravenloft: black spires on a sheer pillar of rock a thousand feet high, its towers lost in low cloud, a single high window lit a deep red. {party}, small at the left edge; a crow on a post. Wide, slightly low camera so the castle towers over everything; grey-green mist pooled in the gorge, the sky a cold bruised violet, the only warmth the lantern and one candle behind a cottage shutter.

burial_strahd.prompt: A dusk churchyard of leaning headstones in long grass; a plain pine coffin on trestles beside a fresh grave, two candles on it. Ireena stands at its head, straight-backed, a hand at the scarf at her throat; Ismark, her broad brother, beside her with a hand on his sword. At the iron lych-gate, where nobody stood a moment ago, Strahd waits just outside the gate in his black high-collared coat and red-lined cape, hat in his gloved hand, smiling like a polite mourner who came late, his breath fogging in sudden cold. {party} in the foreground. Frost creeping over the grass toward the graveside; candle warmth against blue-violet dusk and mist through the bars of the gate.

burial_doru.prompt: A dusk churchyard of leaning headstones in long grass; a plain pine coffin on trestles beside a fresh grave, two candles on it, Ireena and Ismark at its head. On top of the churchyard's stone wall a pale, thin young man crouches like a crow, drawn as his reference shows him, grinning with too many teeth, a message on his lips. {party} in the foreground, turning toward him. Frost on the grass, candle warmth against blue-violet dusk.

burial_graves.prompt: A dusk churchyard from a low angle among the stones: the earth heaves and old graves split along their seams, grey hands and mouldering shoulders of the village dead pushing up through turf and toppled headstones on every side. The iron lych-gate behind is empty, only curling mist. {party} back to back by a plain pine coffin with Ireena and Ismark, Ireena with a sword drawn, lantern light swinging. Grim and shadowed, no gore.

strahd_rides.prompt: Head-on, low camera on a forest road at dusk: out of a bank of grey-green fog between black pines comes Strahd on a huge black warhorse at an unhurried walk, the horse's eyes glowing like banked coals, its breath steaming, Strahd upright and at ease, red-lined cape spilling over the saddle, gloved hand loose on the reins, red eyes on the viewer. In the near foreground, seen from behind and to one side, {party} and Ireena with them, stepping back off the road without meaning to; the lantern throws a warm arc across the mud and the horse's chest. The fog closes behind him like a curtain; violet sky, no sun.

strahd_rides_alone.prompt: Head-on, low camera on a forest road at dusk: out of a bank of grey-green fog between black pines comes Strahd on a huge black warhorse at an unhurried walk, the horse's eyes glowing like banked coals, its breath steaming, Strahd upright and at ease, red-lined cape spilling over the saddle, gloved hand loose on the reins, red eyes on the viewer. In the near foreground, seen from behind and to one side, {party}, stepping back off the road without meaning to; the lantern throws a warm arc across the mud and the horse's chest. The fog closes behind him like a curtain; violet sky, no sun.

crossroads_gallows.prompt: A lonely crossroads by an old stone bridge: a leaning four-armed signpost and, beside it, a wooden gallows where a young Vistani man in a torn red-embroidered vest hangs turning slowly on the rope, black hair hanging across his face, a little silver horse-head earring glinting, a blank wooden board hung round his neck. Behind, a field of low unmarked mounds in long grass, crows on the crossbeam. {party}, small on the road. Overcast grey-violet light, mist on the river; grim and still, his face hidden by his hair, nothing gory.

crossroads_dead.prompt: A lonely crossroads by an old stone bridge at nightfall, seen from low among a field of grave mounds: on the wooden gallows the hanged young man has lifted his head, eyes glowing a faint cold blue through his black hair, and across the field the mounds split open as grey figures claw up out of the earth. {party} on the road, the lantern the only warm light. Moonlight, mist, grim and shadowed, no gore.

tser_falls.prompt: Wide view from a slick rock ledge over a deep pine-dark gorge: a river pours over the edge in one long white rope of water and vanishes into its own spray far below, cold mist rising out of the gorge. A boulder heaped with small offerings (a wooden doll, buttons, grey ribbons) in the foreground; {party}, small on the path behind it. Grey daylight, wet stone shining, grey-green mist, dark pines on the far cliff.

tser_falls_ireena.prompt: Close, from just behind and beside her: Ireena stands alone at the very lip of a great waterfall, too still, spray beading in her long auburn hair, her plum cloak and cream scarf stirred by the updraft, her eyes far away; below her feet the white water drops into nothing and a pine gorge falls away. One cloaked hand reaches toward her arm from the edge of the frame. Cold blue light from the spray, a faint warm rim of lantern light from behind.

madam_eva_reading.prompt: Inside a great patched tent lit purple and amber, a high close camera over a low round table draped in wine-red cloth: five painted fortune cards laid in a cross, four face down and one face up showing an ornate painted figure with no lettering, Madam Eva's thin brown hands with gold bangles laid flat beside them. Madam Eva herself, drawn as her reference shows her, a tiny stooped ancient Vistani seer, looks up past the cards at the viewer with glittering dark eyes. Every candle flame around the table leans the same way at once, smoke streaming sideways, as if a door had opened. The party only hooded shoulders at the table's near edge.

bonegrinder_view.prompt: From the edge of a bare rock crag, the valley of Barovia opens below under a lid of grey cloud: the Svalich road winding between dark pines, the grey roofs and a few chimney threads of a small village, a rutted lane winding up toward the crag, and far off on its pillar of rock a castle with one red window, looking back. Behind the travellers stands a weathered stone windmill with grey canvas sails lashed still in a cross and a dead oak black with silent ravens. {party}, small, standing at the crag's edge looking out over the valley. Cold wind light, grey-green mist in the folds of the valley, the mill's low oven window glowing warm.

bonegrinder_view_burned.prompt: From the edge of a bare rock crag, the valley of Barovia opens below under a lid of grey cloud: the Svalich road winding between dark pines, the grey roofs of a small village, and far off on its pillar of rock a castle with one red window. Behind the travellers, the burned-out black stump of a windmill, its charred sails fallen, thin smoke still rising, a dead oak full of ravens beside it. {party}, small at the crag's edge looking out. Cold wind light, mist in the folds of the valley.

bonegrinder_loft.prompt: A low, warm windmill loft under the great wooden gear of the sails; two iron cages hang on chains from the rafters. In one, a thin fierce girl in a ragged dress grips the bars; in the other a small boy sleeps against the bars with crumbs on his chin. Between them, in a rocking chair worn smooth, a kindly-looking old woman in a flour-dusted shawl shells something small and white into a bowl, smiling at the stair. Oven glow rising through the floorboards, straw and dust in the air; the party is only a lantern at the top of the stair.

bonegrinder_hag.prompt: A low windmill loft under the great wooden gear of the sails, from low down: an old woman rises out of her rocking chair and keeps rising, stretching into the gaunt, horned night hag of the first reference, head bent under the rafters, long black claws spread, the rocking chair tipped over behind her; in the corner a pretty young woman with a red ribbon lays down a mirror, smiling. Two iron cages hang from the rafters. {party} at the top of the stair. Hot orange oven light from below, deep violet shadow above.

ilinca_raven.prompt: Under a dead oak full of watching ravens on a bare crag, a raven lands badly on the rock and is halfway through becoming a small, brisk old woman: black feathers peeling away into a long feather-edged black shawl, a sharp beaky face and bright black eyes emerging, a midwife's apron and satchel, feathers drifting off her sleeves like crumbs. The line between bird and woman is a swirl of feathers. {party} watching nearby. Overcast light, a windmill a dark shape behind.

bonegrinder_burns.prompt: Night on a rocky crag, wide from down the slope: a stone windmill engulfed in roaring orange fire, its four canvas sails burning and turning for the first time in years, sparks streaming up into the black sky. Hundreds of ravens lift off a dead oak in one black sheet and wheel around the flames. {party} small in silhouette in the foreground against the blaze, two small children with them. Firelight against cold violet night and drifting smoke.

festival_sun_blazes.prompt: A walled town's swept square packed shoulder to shoulder with grey townsfolk under sodden yellow bunting; on a pole above a wooden dais a great wicker sun with paper rays, taller than a house, bursts into roaring gold flame. On the dais the portly Baron raises both arms in triumph, his cheerful plump wife beside him, the hulking Izek with his monstrous scaled red arm folded, watching the crowd. Upturned faces lit gold with something near joy; {party} at the back of the crowd. Warm firelight against a dull grey sky and the timber palisade.

festival_sun_dies.prompt: A walled town's square packed with grey townsfolk under sodden yellow bunting, but the great wicker sun on its pole above the dais sits black, steaming and dripping, a sputtering torch held up to it. On the dais the portly Baron's face is purple with fury; the crowd's faces fall; at the edge of the crowd a stern widow in black hides a small smile. {party} at the back of the crowd. Flat cold grey light, steam drifting over the heads.

festival_square.prompt: High camera over a festival square as it breaks apart: on the dais the Baron shouts and points, a hulking man with a scaled red arm beside him, smoke at his knuckles; from the left a stern widow in black mourning steps out of the crowd, chin up, hooded men behind her drawing blades from their sleeves; from the right a priest in a grey cassock with a sunburst stole pushes through with his hands raised for calm. The crowd recoils in a ring, and in the middle of the ring stands {party}, every face turned to them. A half-burnt wicker sun smokes on its pole overhead.

arabelle_dive.prompt: Underwater in a cold lake, looking up: black-green water, weed streaming, the faint grey disc of the surface far above with the dark hull of a jetty. A cloaked, hooded swimmer kicks down from the top of the frame, one arm at full stretch toward a tied sacking bag sinking into the dark below, a small hand showing at its mouth. A thin shaft of grey light, bubbles, cold blue darkness; tense, not gory.

strahd_camp.prompt: A small camp in a forest hollow at the dead of night: a campfire burned low to red embers, bedrolls with sleeping hooded shapes, packs and a propped shield. Low camera from the ground behind the fire: at the very edge of the firelight, among black pine trunks and drifting mist, Strahd stands perfectly still in his black coat and red-lined cape, hands behind his back, red eyes catching the embers, watching. Ireena sits up rigid in her bedroll, auburn hair loose, one hand on the hilt of her sword, staring at him. Ember glow on the near side, cold blue-violet on him.

strahd_camp_alone.prompt: A small camp in a forest hollow at the dead of night: a campfire burned low to red embers, bedrolls with sleeping hooded shapes, packs and a propped shield; one hooded figure on watch has just looked up. Low camera from the ground behind the fire: at the very edge of the firelight, among black pine trunks and drifting mist, Strahd stands perfectly still in his black coat and red-lined cape, hands behind his back, red eyes catching the embers, watching the others sleep. Ember glow on the near side, cold blue-violet on him.

ireena_window.prompt: Inside a dark bedroom at night, camera behind Ireena at the open casement: she stands at the window in a long cream nightgown and a shawl, auburn hair loose, one hand lifted as if to someone helping her down from a carriage. Outside, against a cold moon and steep snowy rooftops, Strahd stands upright on empty air level with the sill, cape stirring, holding out a gloved hand, smiling. The candles are snuffed; her brother is slumped asleep in a chair by the door with a sword across his knees. Cold moonlight pouring in, mist curling over the sill.

ireena_window_empty.prompt: A dark bedroom at night seen from the doorway: the window stands wide on an empty night, curtains lifting, mist pouring in over the sill, and a woman's shawl lies on the floorboards in a pool of cold moonlight. A sword lies dropped beside an empty chair. No figures anywhere. Grief and silence.

vines_gem.prompt: Close and low among brown, dead vine rows on a grey hillside: an old barrel-chested vintner with a big white beard and black raven-bright eyes kneels and presses a glowing leaf-green gem into the soil with his thumb. Green light spills up between his fingers, and the vine above it has just put out one bright new leaf. His family watches from behind him; ravens on every post. {party} nearby. The green is the only saturated colour in a grey-brown world.

yester_effigy.prompt: The flat bare crown of a hill inside a ring of standing stones under a heavy grey sky: a crooked black tree with bark like a burnt hand and roots like fingers in a wound; beside it, lying along the ground, a colossal effigy of earth and timber forty feet long, cloaked, with the gaunt carved face of the man in the second reference. Green-robed druids sway in a ring around it, humming; a tiny grandmotherly old woman with twig-braided grey hair and earth-caked arms presses both hands to its chest. {party}, crouched at the ring's edge in the foreground. Ritual firelight against cold grey.

yester_wintersplinter.prompt: Low dramatic angle on a hilltop ring of standing stones: a colossal effigy of earth and timber splits open at the chest like a log in frost, and out of it unfolds a gigantic walking tree of grey-black gnarled wood with glowing sickly green eyes and a splintered mouth, clawed branch arms reaching higher than the standing stones, roots tearing free of the earth. Green-robed druids fall back; {party}, tiny at its feet. Green glow from inside the split timber against a heavy grey sky.

yester_burn.prompt: A crooked black tree on a hilltop inside a ring of standing stones, wrapped in roaring fire, a thin high scream of steam pouring from it; down the bare slope every little twig and needle creature collapses into heaps of dry brush. Wide, at dusk; {party} in silhouette against the flames.

krezk_reflection.prompt: High camera looking down past Ireena's shoulder into a perfectly round, perfectly still black pool ringed with melted-back snow in a snowy graveyard: Ireena kneels on the stones at the edge, hands flat, auburn hair falling forward. In the water lies her reflection, and beside it a second one, the gentle young nobleman of the second reference in old-fashioned wedding clothes, in pale spectral blue, looking up at her. Beside her on the stones, nobody. The sky in the water is brighter than the grey sky above; snow falling; a white pavilion with a sun statue at the edge of the frame.

abbey_bride.prompt: A cold abbey chapel under a huge gilded sunburst; a dozen hunched misshapen mongrelfolk in rags crowd the aisle humming, holding candles. On a white stone bier lies a beautiful, still young woman in a cream wedding dress embroidered red and black, fine stitched seams like lace at her throat and wrists, a sheer veil and a crown of cream flowers. A serene golden-haired young monk in a cream habit with a leather apron lays both palms on her brow, and every candle in the chapel burns a blinding white. Her mismatched eyes, one brown and one grey, have just opened. {party} watching from the back pews.

abbot_wings.prompt: An abbey chancel from a low angle: the golden-haired young monk stands on the altar step with his hands opened, a mace of pure light in one, and behind him great wings of white-gold light unfurl to fill the whole chancel, feathers edged in fire, his serene face streaked with grief. Every candle has gone white; {party}, small at the foot of the steps, silhouetted against the glare, misshapen mongrelfolk cowering in the pews. Holy white-gold blazing against cold blue stone.

abbot_kneeling.prompt: An abbey chancel under a gilded sunburst: the golden-haired young monk kneels on the altar step, head bowed, and instead of blood, light pours out of him like water from a cracked jar, pooling gold across the flagstones. {party} stands over him, weapons lowered. Every candle burns white; quiet and terrible.

pack_law.prompt: A close cave lit by a single torch and the glow of eyes: a ring of grey and black wolves fills the shadows, dozens of yellow eyes. In the middle, two big men mid-change: a huge bare-chested black-bearded man with a wolf-pelt cloak dropping to all fours, black fur rippling over his back, and an older grey-bearded man with burn scars on his wrists already a lean grey wolf from the shoulders down. {party}, pressed against the cave wall in the foreground. Straw, gnawed bones; torch orange against cave blue-black.

phantom_ride.prompt: A night forest track on a ridge: a column of twenty translucent knights on translucent warhorses thunders past at full gallop, grey as fog, lances up, tattered blue surcoats with silver dragons streaming, every helmeted face turned toward a far ridge, none looking at the viewer. {party}, pressed into the bracken at the verge in the near foreground, the lantern shielded. Frost-blue and lilac ghost light against black pines and a violet sky.

argynvost_frost.prompt: A burned chapel in a dead knightly hall, its floor deep in ash; a single tall window of coloured glass at the far end. Frost is spreading across the glass, and the white frost lines draw on it one long, noble horned head of a silver dragon in profile, with kind, heavy-lidded eyes that glow like two lamps. The dragon exists only as fine white frost lines on the window; there is no dragon in the room. {party} in the foreground looking up at the window, breath fogging. Cold moonlight through the glass.

argynvost_flame.prompt: A long stone vault; along a raised stone bier lies the whole skeleton of a huge dragon, wings folded like a cloak, ribs furred with white frost, but its skull is missing: the long neck bones end in nothing. A hooded figure holds a torch to the frost on the ribs and the torch's flame has turned pure silver, casting no shadow. Silver light against blue stone; the rest of the party watching from the dark.

beacon_lit_vladimir.prompt: The top of a round beacon tower at night above a vast dark forested valley: a great iron cradle bursts into tall silver fire without smoke, and a broad beam of silver light pours out of it over the low parapet and across the whole valley, laying a pale silver road over the treetops all the way to a castle on a distant pillar of rock. A gaunt dead commander in black dragon-scale plate sits with his back to the parapet, sword across his knees, his face turned to the light; a big grey-skinned knight in a faded blue surcoat shuts his eyes in it. {party}, small beside the cradle.

beacon_lit.prompt: The top of a round beacon tower at night: a great iron cradle bursts into tall silver fire without smoke, and its light pours over the low parapet and out across a vast dark forested valley, laying a pale silver road over the treetops all the way to a castle on a distant pillar of rock. A big grey-skinned dead knight in a faded blue surcoat shuts his eyes in the light. {party}, small beside the cradle.

beacon_road.prompt: From a night road on a rise, wide: far off on its ridge a ruined mansion's tower burns silver, and a pale beam of light lies across the black treetops toward a castle on a pillar of rock; below the road a farmhouse shutter stands open with a candle in it. {party}, small in the foreground, looking at the light.

order_rides.prompt: A long burned feasting hall in a dead knights' mansion: along a long table the dead knights rise from their chairs in tattered blue surcoats, swords sliding back into their scabbards, faces grey and set, and file toward a great door thrown open on the night, cold blowing in and guttering the candles. At their head a gaunt commander in black dragon-scale plate. {party} standing aside by the wall.

lysaga_hut.prompt: A drowned village marsh at dusk, broken walls standing out of black water, reeds taller than a man, scarecrows on poles. On a stump wider than a house, a ramshackle thatched witch's hut tears itself up on two huge gnarled root legs shaped like clawed bird feet, swaying upright, its door banging like a jaw, two windows glowing green. Low camera from the mud; {party}, small and braced in the foreground. Green witchlight against violet dusk and grey-green marsh mist.

lysaga_bowl.prompt: Over the reeds of a black marsh toward a white statue on a dry mound, a great bowl of yellowed bone skims low and fast, and standing in it the tiny furious ancient witch of the reference, wild white hair streaming; behind her the whole marsh rises as a black cloud of insects. A small iron grave-lamp burns at the statue's feet, {party} beside it. Dusk, green and violet.

marina_statue.prompt: On a small dry mound in a black marsh stands a white stone statue of a young woman with folded hands, her face turned toward a distant castle, fresh black roses and an unlit iron grave-lamp at her feet. At the foot of the mound Ireena has stopped dead, looking up at a stone face that is exactly her own. Overcast grey light, reeds, {party} behind her.

marina_rose.prompt: Night at a white stone statue of a young woman on a dry mound in a black marsh: Strahd stands at its foot half turned away from us, laying a single black rose among the others with a gloved hand, his red-lined cape pooling on the wet grass, his face in profile grave and quiet. Moonlight on the white stone, the marsh in mist; {party}, small along a causeway, approaching.

mordenkainen_jar.prompt: A cold one-room mountain hut, a game board furred with frost on the table, every piece black. A gaunt old wizard, drawn as his reference shows him, with a tangled grey-white beard full of twigs and wild white hair, sits rigid as a stream of silver smoke pours up out of an open blue glass jar held by a cloaked hand and flows into his eyes, his face caught between vacant and fierce. Snow at the window, silver light on his face.

roc_shadow.prompt: A high mountain road along a cliff above a sea of cloud, a narrow stone bridge over a gorge. A colossal bird of prey fills the whole upper half of the sky, so huge that the travellers on the road below are tiny specks beside one of its talons: dark brown and grey feathers, a pale head, a huge hooked yellow beak, wings wider than a barn roof, banking low over the ridge and turning its head to look down. Its vast shadow covers the road and the bridge, where {party} crouch flat on the stones. Cold thin sunlight, snow streaming off the ridge.

amber_sentinels.prompt: A wind-scoured snow ledge high on a mountain before a great door cut into the rock face; two hooded, robed colossi of glowing translucent amber flank it, each three times a man's height, the left split from crown to knee and packed with snow, the right turning its faceless hood toward the viewer with two golden points for eyes. Below the ledge the whole valley lies hidden under a white lid of cloud. {party}, tiny on the ledge. Warm amber glow against icy blue.

amber_sentinel_steps.prompt: Low angle on a snowy mountain ledge before a great carved door: a hooded colossus of glowing translucent amber, three times a man's height, steps down off its plinth, snow and ice cracking off its amber robes, a massive hand raised, the ledge shaking; {party} scattering at its feet. Warm amber glow against icy blue.

amber_gift.prompt: A dreamlike split picture: below, a hooded figure lies with eyes closed in a man-shaped hollow of glowing amber in a dark vault; above and around, as if seen through the amber, the whole valley of Barovia spreads out at night, threads of red light running like veins along its roads, rivers and graveyards, all converging on a castle on a pillar of rock where a tall dark figure on the battlements turns his head toward the viewer. Honey-gold glow bleeding into night violet; uncanny and quiet.

amber_pact.prompt: A memory of four centuries ago, tinted in warm sepia and amber: a younger, living Strahd, gaunt but not yet pale, in a prince's dark, war-worn coat, kneels before a great hollow amber sarcophagus in a candlelit vault, while a courteous living old man, a temple warden with a white beard in a tea-coloured robe, holds up a lantern and a copper book. Out of the empty amber a shape of darkness leans toward the kneeling prince like a voice. Dread and longing, no blood. The picture fills the frame edge to edge with no border, frame or paper.

black_carriage.prompt: A misty forest road at dusk: a polished black carriage with no driver stands in the middle of the road, its door open on red velvet seats and a letter sealed in black wax, drawn by exactly two tall black horses with plain black manes and eyes like red embers, utterly still, breath steaming. {party}, small on the road in front of it. Cold violet dusk, a castle faint on its cliff above the trees.

carriage_ride.prompt: Seen from far below: a black carriage with its lamps lit races up a switchback mountain road into the clouds toward a castle on a pillar of rock, two black horses at full stretch, mist streaming off the wheels. Night, cold violet sky, the castle's single window red.

castle_chasm.prompt: The end of a mountain road among dead pines at night: a sheer chasm with no visible bottom, filled with mist, and across it Castle Ravenloft rising from the rock as if it grew there, black walls, spires lost in cloud, a single high window lit. The drawbridge is already down, a long span of black planks; the portcullis is up. {party}, small at the near edge, lantern held up. Cold moonlight, bats circling the towers.

castle_chasm_carriage.prompt: Night at the edge of a bottomless mist-filled chasm: a black driverless carriage drawn by two black horses rolls without slowing over a long lowered drawbridge of black planks toward Castle Ravenloft, which rises from the far rock as if it grew there, spires lost in cloud, one high window lit. Hooded faces at the carriage window. Cold moonlight, bats circling the towers.

dinner_organ.prompt: A vast dining hall in a gothic castle: a long table laid for guests with real silver, hot food and tall candelabra, a chair pulled out for each guest, nobody serving. At the far end, beneath the towering pipes of a great organ, Strahd has just closed the lid and turns on the bench toward the viewer, one arm along the organ, smiling with courteous menace. {party} at the near end of the table. Candle gold against black vaults; bats hanging in the dark above the pipes.

dinner_organ_ireena.prompt: A vast dining hall in a gothic castle: a long table laid for guests with real silver, hot food and tall candelabra, a chair pulled out for each guest, nobody serving. At the far end, beneath the towering pipes of a great organ, Strahd has just closed the lid and turns on the bench toward the viewer, one arm along the organ, smiling with courteous menace. {party} at the near end of the table; Ireena standing behind a chair, refusing to sit, her eyes on him. Candle gold against black vaults; bats hanging in the dark above the pipes.

heart_beats.prompt: A round chamber at the top of a castle tower, windows on every side full of grey sky and cloud: in the middle, hung on chains that vanish into the roof, a heart of red crystal taller than a man, cut into a thousand faces, glowing and fading with each slow beat; a dark drop gathers at its point and falls onto the dais. {party}, small at the top of the stair, lit red from below. Red pulse against cold grey.

heart_breaks.prompt: A round chamber at the top of a castle tower: a heart of red crystal taller than a man bursts into a storm of red glass shards and a flood of red light streaming out through the windows on every side; {party} shielding their faces, the chains swinging empty above.

sergei_font.prompt: A clean white tomb with candles nobody lit; Ireena kneels at a round basin of still black water at the foot of a white sarcophagus carved with a young man holding a sword, and in the water beside her own reflection is the spectral face of that young man, looking up at her. Warm candlelight on white stone, cold blue in the water.

chapel_dawn.prompt: A ruined castle chapel with split pews and an upside-down sunburst nailed over the altar; on the altar step a small hooded figure seen from behind sings with hands open, and through the tall stained-glass windows real dawn pours in, gold then white, laying coloured light over the dust, the pews and the rest of {party}. Things in the shadows of the walls recoil from the light. Warm gold flooding a cold blue-black room.

final_overlook.prompt: A terrace of worn flagstones along a castle keep's wall at night; past the parapet the cliff drops a thousand feet into mist and the whole valley spreads below, forest, river and the tiny lights of a village. At the far end Strahd stands at the parapet with his back to the viewer, cape stirring, just turning his head, a red eye catching the moon, hands folded behind him like a host at the top of his own stair. {party} advancing along the terrace in the foreground; below the wall a cloud of bats begins to rise. Moonlight and mist, one torch on the wall.

final_chapel.prompt: A ruined castle chapel by candlelight, split pews and an upside-down sunburst over the altar: Strahd has just risen from kneeling at the altar and turns toward the viewer, cape swinging, while in the front pews two pale vampire brides in old gowns stand up with him. {party} advancing up the aisle in the foreground. Candle gold against blue-black stone.

final_audience_hall.prompt: A great castle audience hall: Strahd lounges on a high throne, one leg over its arm, as if he has waited a long time and enjoyed every minute, and two great wolves rise from the dais steps with bared teeth. Tall dark tapestries, braziers, {party} advancing across the floor in the foreground. Firelight against black vaults.

final_sergeis_tomb.prompt: A clean white tomb in castle catacombs: Strahd stands at the foot of a white sarcophagus carved with a young man holding a sword, one gloved hand resting on the stone, finishing something he was saying to it before he turns his head toward the viewer. {party} in the doorway in the foreground. Candlelight on white stone, cold blue shadow.

final_strahds_tomb.prompt: A square vault at the foot of a black stair, green fire in iron braziers, a plain wooden coffin on trestles on a stepped dais: Strahd stands beside his own coffin with his hands behind his back, like a man waiting for a late carriage, and looks at the viewer. {party} at the foot of the stair in the foreground. Green brazier light against black stone.

final_hall_of_bones.prompt: A dungeon hall with a long table built of bones under a lamp made of a skull: at its head Strahd rises from his chair, and along both sides the chairs of bone stand up with him. {party} at the near end of the table in the foreground. Sickly lamplight against blue-black dark; grim, no gore.

final_royal_tomb.prompt: A royal tomb in castle catacombs: Strahd sits on the edge of a dais between two old stone tombs carved with a king and a queen, and the shadows of the vault stand up around him like figures. {party} in the doorway in the foreground. Candlelight on old stone, deep violet shadow.

final_catacombs.prompt: Castle catacombs with a stable stall cut into the rock: a huge jet-black warhorse with a black mane and eyes like red embers lifts its head from a stone manger, and the man standing beside it, Strahd, turns around toward the viewer, one hand on the horse's neck. {party} advancing between the crypt niches in the foreground. Torchlight against blue-black stone.

final_heart.prompt: A round chamber at the top of a castle tower, windows full of grey cloud: Strahd stands beside a heart of red crystal taller than a man hung on chains, one hand resting on the glass the way a man rests a hand on a horse he is fond of, and every slow beat lights his face red from below. {party} at the top of the stair.

final_study.prompt: A castle study with dark panelling: Strahd sits reading by the fire under a large portrait of a young auburn-haired woman, finishing his page before he looks up, marking it with a ribbon, while the chimney fills with bats. {party} in the doorway in the foreground. Warm firelight against cold shadow.

final_treasury.prompt: A castle treasury: Strahd sits on his hoard in a chair that has sunk to its knees in gold coins, turning one coin over in his fingers, while behind him an empty suit of armour draws its sword. {party} in the doorway in the foreground. Candle gold glinting off the coins against black stone.

strahd_end_sun.prompt: A square vault at the foot of a black stair, green fire in iron braziers, a plain wooden coffin on trestles on a stepped dais. A hooded figure seen from behind holds up a sword whose blade is pure sunlight, and the light falls straight down into the coffin, where Strahd, lying with his hands folded, comes apart like burning paper, edges first, into drifting grey ash and embers, his face calm, almost relieved. The room is filled for the first time with warm gold morning; the green braziers gutter.

strahd_end_ireena.prompt: A square vault at the foot of a black stair, green fire in iron braziers: Ireena kneels on the edge of an open wooden coffin with a wooden stake held in both hands above the heart of Strahd, who lies in it with his red eyes open and fixed on her; her auburn hair falls forward, her face set and quiet. Green brazier light and a single lantern; restrained, no blood.

ending_dawn.prompt: From a castle gate at first light, the mist thin and tearing: a small pale sun rises over the mountain rim and lays the first gold on a valley, the village roofs, the forest and a river; {party} stands on the lowered drawbridge, weapons lowered, looking at it. Warm, quiet, a little disbelieving; the cold blue night retreating west.

ending_sergei.prompt: A round pool in a snowy mountain graveyard at sunrise, the water glowing gold: Ireena, seen from behind, walks into it to her knees toward the spectral young man in old-fashioned wedding clothes who reaches for her hand from the bright surface. On the stones behind, her broad brother and {party} let her go. Snow falling, warm gold light, quiet.

ending_bride.prompt: Seen from a valley road at night: Castle Ravenloft on its pillar of rock blazes with every window lit, music drifting down into the mist; in the foreground {party} walks away down the road with their backs to it, not looking back.

ending_mists.prompt: Dusk over a small village from above, church bells tolling: mist pours down the mountainsides like a slow tide over the roofs, the castle window on its distant rock red; on the empty eastern road at the mist's edge, a black carriage waits for the next strangers. No people.

ending_darklord.prompt: A castle's great doors opening from inside onto night: a single hooded hero seen from behind stands on the threshold while grey mist curls around their boots like a fawning hound; below in the courtyard a black carriage is made ready, bats circling the towers; behind in the hall the rest of the party stands small and uneasy.
